places.name: Lalbagh Botanical Garden
places.summary: Botanical garden with an aquarium & glasshouse designed to mimic London's former Crystal Palace.

places.name: ISKCON Bangalore
places.address: Hare Krishna Hill, Chord Rd, 1st R Block, Rajajinagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560010
places.summary: Expansive, modern Hare Krishna temple campus, including shrines, food stalls & souvenir shops.

places.name: Visvesvaraya Industrial & Technological Museum
places.address: 5216, Kasturba Rd, near Chinna Swamy Stadium, Ambedkar Veedhi, Bengaluru, Karnataka 5
places.summary: Family-friendly technology & science museum with exhibits on engines, space, biotechnology & more.

places.name: Shri Someshwara Swamy Temple (ulsoor)
places.address: Sri, Someshwara Temple Rd, Halasuru, Someshwarpura, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560008
places.summary: Built for the god Shiva during the Chola period, this Hindu temple features carvings of deities.

places.name: Bannerghatta hills
places.summary: A well-rated Bengaluru tourist attraction stop, useful for a balanced city itinerary.

places.name: Bugle Rock Park
places.address: WHV9+3QM, Bull Temple Rd, Basavanagudi, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560004
places.summary: Serene park shaded by a tree canopy featuring gardens, waterfalls & fountains, plus three temples.

places.name: Sri Chamarajendra Park
places.summary: Established in 1870, this vibrant city park has walking paths, landscaped gardens & play areas.

places.name: Bengaluru Palace
places.summary: Modern royal palace modeled on Windsor Castle offering tours, outdoor concerts & an amusement park.

places.name: Bengaluru Fort
places.address: XH7G+49C, Krishna Rajendra Rd, New Tharagupet, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560002
places.summary: Monumental, carved stone gate, one of few surviving elements of the city's 18th-century fort.
